item.title: Thailand’s New Political Status Symbol Is a $60 Casio Watch
item.description: In Thai politics, where luxury watches are a familiar status symbol, the latest must-have costs less than $60 and comes from the prime minister.
item.dc:creator: Patpicha Tanakasempipat

item.title: Justice Department Subpoenas Relatives of Representative Omar
item.description: Federal investigators have issued subpoenas to the relatives of Representative Ilhan Omar, who is facing a criminal probe that includes a review of her immigration history, according to a person familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Chris Strohm

item.title: Saudi Aramco Headquarters Hit During Houthi Attacks
item.description: "Balance of Power" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Rep. Julia Letlow (R-LA), Republican Nominee for the US Senate from Louisiana, says high diesel prices are putting pressure on farmers during harvest season, with some producers talking about going under. Kevin Book, ClearView Energy Partners managing director, says additional Russian diesel is unlikely to offset the roughly 70% run-up in diesel prices, though he estimates increased volumes could provide roughly 5 to 20 cents a gallon in relief by the end of the fourth quarter. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: India’s Jaishankar Outlines Key Foreign Policy Objectives
item.description: India’s External Affairs Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar laid out his country’s approach to some of its most consequential relationships in a wide-ranging interview with Bloomberg Editor-in-Chief John Micklethwait on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Swati Pandey

item.title: Rubio Plans India Trip Next Week Focused on Energy, Investment
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel to India next week for a visit focused on deepening cooperation in energy and spurring investment and economic opportunities.
item.dc:creator: Eric Martin

item.title: Book Says Russian Diesel Won’t Offset Price Surge
item.description: Kevin Book, ClearView Energy Partners managing director, says additional Russian diesel is unlikely to offset the roughly 70% run-up in diesel prices, though he estimates increased volumes could provide roughly 5 to 20 cents a gallon in relief by the end of the fourth quarter. Book also warns that further escalation in the Middle East could put more critical Saudi energy infrastructure at risk, potentially creating a much larger disruption to oil markets. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Calls on Hochul to Remove James From Cornell Investigation
item.description: President Donald Trump called on New York’s governor to remove state Attorney General Letitia James from the investigation into an alleged rape at Cornell University, injecting himself into a case that has drawn national attention.
item.dc:creator: Josh Wingrove

item.title: Rep. Letlow Says Farmers Need Relief From Diesel Prices
item.description: Rep. Julia Letlow (R-LA), Republican Nominee for the US Senate from Louisiana, says high diesel prices are putting pressure on farmers during harvest season, with some producers talking about going under. Rep. Letlow says she appreciates the Trump administration looking at every avenue possible to bring prices down, acknowledging that some of those solutions have been controversial. Rep. Lutlow also discusses her Know Your Risk Act, which would direct the government to develop a common breast cancer risk assessment tool to help individuals better understand their risk. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Carney Heads to Alberta Days Before Canada Separation Vote
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney is heading to Alberta days before residents of the oil-rich province head to the polls to vote on a referendum to remain in Canada or seek independence.
item.dc:creator: Robert Tuttle

item.title: Bank Earnings, AI & the Health of the Economy
item.description: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Wells Fargo CFO Mike Santomassimo, Golfer Rory McIlroy, Jefferies Equity Research Analyst David Chiaverini, PSP Growth Managing Director, Head of Venture Momei Qu, Applied Materials CEO & President Gary Dickerson, RBC Capital Markets Head of Derivatives Strategy Amy Wu Silverman, Advisors Capital Management Co-Founder & CIO Chuck Lieberman, Brookfield Asset Management CEO Connor Teskey, Blackstone President & COO Jonathan Gray, Vista Equity Partners Founder, Chairman & CEO Robert Smith, & Barclays Senior Equity Analyst Jason Goldberg. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily Podcast: Big Bank Earnings Begin
item.description:
The people, companies and trends shaping the global economy. Watch Carol and Tim LIVE every day on YouTube: http://bit.ly/3vTiACF
A selloff in chipmakers deepened on concerns about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence trade, weighing on stocks as Wall Street banks kicked off the earnings season. In a renewed bout of weakness, a closely watched gauge of semiconductor powerhouses extended its plunge from a June record, while concerns linked to artificial intelligence propagate across sectors. Meantime, New York Fed President John Williams said he still sees one more interest-rate hike as appropriate this year.
On today's episode: Herman Chan, Bloomberg Intelligence Senior US Banks Analyst Mamadou-Abou Sarr, Founder & President at V-Square Gautam Mukunda, Bloomberg Opinion Columnist Natalia Emanuel, New York Fed Economist (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: ‘Rudely Aggressive’: Trump Pressures CEOs to Bring Nations in Line Freeland Says
item.description: US President Donald Trump’s administration privately pressures foreign CEOs and business leaders to bring their governments into line with the White House’s demands, Canada’s former deputy prime minister says in a new memoir.
item.dc:creator: Laura Dhillon Kane

item.title: Burnham Hosts Zelenskyy as UK Grapples With Trump-Russia Policy
item.description: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham will host Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in London on Wednesday as Kyiv and its allies scramble to respond to President Donald Trump’s diesel deal with Russia.
item.dc:creator: Alex Wickham

item.title: Houthis Hit Saudi Aramco Headquarters in Missile Attack
item.description: Saudi Aramco’s headquarters in Dhahran was hit during a missile attack by Yemen’s Houthi militants. A fire broke out in part of the complex. This is according to people with knowledge of the matter. The Houthis have launched several missile attacks against Saudi Arabia in recent days. Kailey Leinz reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bond Traders Eclipsed by Equities in Wall Street Reversal
item.description: As Wall Street’s fixed-income desks struggled in the third quarter, their rivals in equities seized a rare opening to outshine their market brethren. Herman Chan of Bloomberg Intelligence breaks down the day's big bank earnings. KKR Partner Alisa Wood discusses the firm's strategy and the current exit environment with Bloomberg's Dani Burger. New York Fed President John Williams said he still sees one more interest-rate hike as appropriate this year. Bloomberg's Mike McKee joins with reaction to the day's Fed speak. Plus - Samsara CEO Sanjit Biswas discusses the launch of the company's Agent Studio and how AI agents are moving into the physical world. All on the latest episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: ¿Es legal el plan de Trump para importar diésel de Rusia?

item.dc:creator: Jimmy Jenkins

item.title: Trump Tries a New Press Secretary With Midterm Problems Mounting
item.description: Katia Zacharia, the president’s new press secretary, will have to tout his record to voters unhappy with their cost of living.
item.dc:creator: Jeff Mason

item.title: KKR Partner Alisa Wood Sees Record Year in Private Equity Exits
item.description: Alisa Wood, partner at investment company KKR, said that her firm has broken its previous record for asset sales because it is 'linear' in how it exists businesses and doesn't wait for businesses to reach the IPO market before selling. Speaking to Bloomberg's Dani Burger at the CAIS Summit in Beverly Hills, Wood commented on the crowded private equity landscape and said that there are too many funds, potentially limiting smaller managers ability to grow value. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Faces Growing GOP Revolt Over His Russian Diesel Deal
item.description: President Donald Trump confronts growing opposition within his own party to his deal with Vladimir Putin on Moscow’s exports of diesel, reached just weeks after he signed a law authorizing stiff sanctions on countries that buy Russian oil.
item.dc:creator: Steven T. Dennis

item.title: Guilfoyle Ousted as US Ambassador to Greece Amid Conduct Probe
item.description: President Donald Trump ousted his US Ambassador to Greece, Kimberly Guilfoyle, following allegations of unethical conduct.
item.dc:creator: Josh Wingrove and Viktoria Dendrinou
